title: Herdr is joining Y Combinator. The runtime stays open
summary: Herdr announces its acceptance into Y Combinator while maintaining an open runtime model, indicating a startup that balances commercial growth with open-source principles. The company appears to be in the developer tools or infrastructure space.
problem_solved: Provides open runtime infrastructure while offering commercial services through Y Combinator's accelerator program.
why_valuable: Y Combinator backing validates the business model while keeping the runtime open attracts developer adoption and community contribution.
